subject: AuroraHealth: PrivNet readiness & evidence plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@aurorahealth.com>, Tom Gallagher <t.gallagher@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-25T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + asks from today’s privnet discovery

Thanks for a productive call today — appreciate the clarity on AuroraHealth’s scope and timeline. I’m capturing the immediate asks and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key context (from call)
- Scope: initial proof-of-concept to serve clinical decision support models for a single hospital cluster (non-billing PHI subset).
- Target POC timeline: late-Nov start, 4–6 week validation.
- Must-haves: BAA in place, network isolation (VPC or on-prem), demonstrable SOC 2 posture, data-at-rest encryption with customer-managed keys.

Immediate asks for AuroraHealth (what we need to qualify and scope work)
1) SOC 2 status: Do you have a SOC 2 Type I/II report or an audit in-flight? If in-flight, estimated delivery dates.
2) Regulatory classification: Confirmation that the dataset for POC is limited PHI (HIPAA) and whether GDPR concerns apply for any EU-resident data.
3) Vendor security questionnaire: Please complete the attached vendor questionnaire (worksheet v1) and return. It helps us map what evidence you can provide versus what we need to produce.
4) Network sketch: a simple diagram showing where the model inference will run (cloud VPC vs on-prem), connectivity (VPN/DirectConnect), and any air-gap requirement. A partial sketch is fine — we’ll iterate.
5) Procurement contacts & timeline: procurement/legal touchpoints for BAA and commercial terms.

Our commitments and options (to help you plan)
- Private (VPC) deployment: Redwood will provide a dedicated VPC with tenant isolation, optional customer-managed KMS integration (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault), and audit logs.
- On-prem / air-gapped: We support an air-gapped on-prem package for regulated workloads; we’ll need architecture-level alignment on hardware, network egress controls, and patching cadence.
- Evidence we can share immediately: SOC 2 readiness checklist, redwood-privnet-readiness-checklist.pdf (attached).

Next steps (proposed)
- Aurora: return filled vendor questionnaire + network sketch by EOD 2028-10-29.
- Redwood: SE deep-dive with Marissa to run architecture options and produce a recommended deployment sketch (target 2028-10-31).
- Schedule: propose follow-up call week of 2028-11-06 (30–45 min) for technical alignment.

Attachments: aurora-vendor-questionnaire-v1.xlsx, redwood-privnet-readiness-checklist.pdf

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the SE slot once you confirm availability.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@aurorahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <t.gallagher@aurorahealth.com>, Aurora Legal <legal@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2028-10-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today’s privnet discovery

Thanks, Logan — good write-up. Quick answers inline and a partial network sketch attached.

1) SOC 2: We do not have a current Type II. Type I audit is scheduled for 2028-11-20; Type II planned for Q2 2029. We can share the SOC scoping memo and our internal controls matrix this week.
2) Regulatory class: POC dataset will include limited PHI (patient identifiers will be pseudonymized where possible). No EU data expected for the initial POC. We will need a BAA.
3) Vendor questionnaire: starting to fill it now — will return a draft by 2028-10-29.
4) Network sketch: attached aurora-network-sketch-partial.png — currently we plan a colocated inference cluster in our private subnet behind a firewall, with TLS over DirectConnect to the app tier.

Air-gap question: we’re evaluating an air-gapped option for later phases. Can Redwood support a one-way data diode setup (ingest-only) or a fully isolated on-prem package with no outbound connectivity?

Procurement: looping in our procurement lead (Tom) and legal. Tom, can you confirm procurement timeline for BAAs and PO processing?

Available for the week of 2028-11-06 for the SE call.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Senior Program Manager, Data & Integrations | AuroraHealth
sofia.ramos@aurorahealth.com

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-27T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: draft questionnaire answers + deployment notes for AuroraHealth

Quick internal notes and recommended response posture for Aurora’s questionnaire and air-gap ask.

Summary (for Logan to share)
- SOC 2: we can provide a SOC readiness statement and our controls mapping. Because Aurora’s Type I is in Nov, flag that a Type II won’t be available until after their POC window — recommend we accept internal controls evidence + third-party roadmap for the POC.
- BAA: Standard Redwood BAA exists; legal can expedite a template for review.
- KMS: Recommend offering customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault). For air-gapped on-prem, propose an HSM option (Thales/CloudHSM equivalent) as part of the deployment quote.
- Network: For POC we can run Private (VPC) with DirectConnect/VPN. For air-gap, we support a fully isolated on-prem bundle; constraints: no outbound telemetry, customer-managed patching window (we can provide images), and longer lead times for hardware procurement.

Attachments to prepare to send (we should create these)
- Completed vendor questionnaire (draft) — use privacy-preserving responses where Aurora will supply evidentiary docs.
- SE deployment sketch (recommended) — Marissa to own.
- Evidence pack: SOC readiness statement, KMS integration guide snippet, BAA template.

Ask: Marissa, can you carve 60–90 minutes with Aurora for a technical walkthrough the week of 2028-11-06? I’ll draft the questionnaire responses and attach suggested evidence.

Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-10-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today’s privnet discovery — consolidated next steps

Thanks all — consolidating and confirming next actions so we don’t lose momentum.

What Redwood will do now
- Marissa will set up a 60–90 minute SE deep-dive (proposed slots: 2028-11-07 10:00 PDT or 2028-11-08 14:00 PDT). Please pick a slot.
- Monica will circulate a draft of the completed vendor questionnaire (attached) and the SOC readiness statement by 2028-10-31.
- I’ll send a template BAA and our KMS integration notes.

Requests from Aurora (please confirm)
- Return the vendor questionnaire + any evidentiary docs (SOC scoping memo, firewall rule export, or infrastructure contact notes) by EOD 2028-10-29 — Sofia, you indicated a draft that day; if you need an extra 48 hours, let us know.
- Confirm whether you require a one-way data diode versus fully air-gapped on-prem for phase 2 so we can model costs.

Attachments included: aurora-vendor-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (draft completed by Redwood), redwood-privnet-readiness-checklist.pdf

Next meeting: awaiting Aurora confirmation for SE slot; once chosen we’ll share a short agenda (network diagram review, KMS/HSM options, telemetry & audit log handling).

Thanks — looking forward.

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
